entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: By way of this application, the applicants seek leave to appeal.
The applicants before this Court are claiming to be the trustees of Shri Varah Swaroop Mandir and Shri Bhutnath Mahadev Trust.

It is submitted that the respondent no.4 herein, in his capacity as a 'Mahant', was the original claimant in the acquisition proceedings and he expired in the year 2008 leaving behind no any legal representative, therefore, the respondent no.4 may be permitted to be deleted.

sentences.text: Learned advocate for the applicants submitted that the applicants are the trustees of the aforesaid Trust whose interest is involved in the lands which belong to the Trust.
The Land Reference Cases Nos.500 and 501 of 2017 were the proceedings initiated in connection with the acquisition of the lands belonging to the Trust.

entities.text: Land Reference Cases Nos.500 and 501 of 2017
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: From the pleadings, it appears that the applicants, being the trustees and their interest is involved to the extent that the compensation under the Land Acquisition Act may not be disbursed to any person/individual but in favour of the Trust only, have filed this application.
Learned advocate appearing for the acquiring body as well as the State have no formal objection in allowing such application.
